contents:
[package]
name = "falcao-bytecode"
description = "Gerador de bytecode do motor JavaScript Falcão (árvore + escopos → bytecode)"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.98.1"
publish = false
license = "MIT"
repository = "https://github.com/feather-works/falcao"

[dependencies.falcao-sintaxe]
path = "../falcao-sintaxe"

[package]
name = "falcao-runtime"
description = "Valores, gaiola, formas, objetos, coletor e intérprete do motor JavaScript Falcão"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.98.1"
publish = false
license = "MIT"
repository = "https://github.com/feather-works/falcao"

[dependencies.falcao-sintaxe]
path = "../falcao-sintaxe"

[dependencies.falcao-bytecode]
path = "../falcao-bytecode"

[package]
name = "falcao-sintaxe"
description = "Léxico, sintaxe e escopos do motor JavaScript Falcão"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.98.1"
publish = false
license = "MIT"
repository = "https://github.com/feather-works/falcao"

[dependencies]

[package]
name = "feather-charts"
version = "0.3.4"
description = "Motor de gráficos da suíte FeatherWorks: dados, geometria, eixos, 25 tipos de gráfico, estilos visuais e temáticas, interação e saída em cena vetorial, SVG e PDF"
authors = ["FeatherWorks"]
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.77.2"
license = "MIT"
repository = "https://github.com/feather-works/feather-charts"
publish = false

[dependencies]
serde_json = "1"

[dependencies.feather-draw]
git = "https://github.com/feather-works/feather-draw"
tag = "v0.1.1"

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1"
features = ["derive"]

[package]
name = "feather-draw"
version = "0.1.1"
description = "Motor vetorial compartilhado da suíte FeatherOffice: geometria, caminhos, estilos, SVG, PDF, unidades e tinta com pressão da caneta"
authors = ["FeatherOffice"]
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.77.2"
license = "GPL-3.0-only"
repository = "https://github.com/FeatherOffice/feather-draw"
publish = false

[package]
name = "feather-image"
description = "Operacoes independentes em pixels RGBA"
version = "0.2.1"
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.77.2"
license = "MIT"
repository = "https://github.com/feather-works/feather-io"

[dependencies.image]
version = "0.25"
default-features = false

[package]
name = "feather-io"
description = "Contratos de codecs e conversao entre formatos"
version = "0.2.1"
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.77.2"
license = "MIT"
repository = "https://github.com/feather-works/feather-io"

[dependencies.feather-charts]
git = "https://github.com/feather-works/feather-charts"
tag = "v0.3.4"

[dependencies.feather-tables]
path = "../feather-tables"

[dependencies.feather-image]
path = "../feather-image"

[dependencies.feather-draw]
git = "https://github.com/feather-works/feather-draw"
tag = "v0.1.1"

[dependencies.image]
version = "0.25"
default-features = false
features = ["png"]

[dependencies.zip]
version = "4.2.0"
default-features = false
features = ["deflate"]

[package]
name = "feather-macros"
version = "0.2.1"
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.77.2"
license = "MIT"
repository = "https://github.com/feather-works/feather-io"
description = "Motor de macros JavaScript reutilizável entre os aplicativos da suíte FeatherWorks"

[dependencies]
boa_gc = "0.22"
serde_json = "1"

[dependencies.boa_engine]
version = "0.22"
default-features = false

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1"
features = ["derive"]

[dependencies.falcao-runtime]
git = "https://github.com/feather-works/falcao"
tag = "v0.1.1"
optional = true

[features]
falcao = ["dep:falcao-runtime"]

[package]
name = "feather-shapes"
version = "0.1.2"
description = "Formas, ícones e SmartArt compartilhados da suíte FeatherWorks: catálogo de formas, geometria, aparência, operações booleanas, ícones Tabler e diagramas, entregues como Cena do feather-draw"
authors = ["FeatherWorks"]
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.77.2"
license = "GPL-3.0-only"
repository = "https://github.com/feather-works/feather-shapes"
publish = false
include = ["src/**", "dados/**", "tools/**", "Cargo.toml", "README.md", "LICENSE"]

[lib]
name = "feather_shapes"

[dependencies.feather-draw]
git = "https://github.com/feather-works/feather-draw"
tag = "v0.1.1"

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1"
features = ["derive"]

[package]
name = "feather-tables"
description = "Modelo esparso de tabelas e estilos reutilizaveis"
version = "0.2.1"
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.77.2"
license = "MIT"
repository = "https://github.com/feather-works/feather-io"

[package]
name = "feather-ui"
version = "0.3.13"
description = "Interface compartilhada da suíte FeatherWorks: tema, ícones, marca e componentes (pelicano)"
authors = ["FeatherWorks"]
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.77.2"
license = "MIT"
repository = "https://github.com/feather-works/feather-ui"
publish = false

[dependencies.pelicano]
git = "https://github.com/feather-works/pelicano.git"
tag = "v0.1.27"

[target."cfg(all(unix, not(target_os = \"macos\"), not(target_os = \"android\")))".dependencies.x11rb]
version = "0.13"
features = ["xinput"]

[target."cfg(all(unix, not(target_os = \"macos\"), not(target_os = \"android\")))".dev-dependencies.x11rb]
version = "0.13"
features = ["xinput", "xtest"]

[target."cfg(windows)".dependencies.windows-sys]
version = "0.59"
features = ["Win32_Foundation", "Win32_UI_Shell", "Win32_UI_Input_Pointer", "Win32_UI_WindowsAndMessaging", "Win32_System_ProcessStatus", "Win32_System_Threading", "Win32_System_SystemInformation"]

[target."cfg(target_os = \"linux\")".dev-dependencies]
wayland-client = "0.31"
libc = "0.2"

[target."cfg(target_os = \"linux\")".dev-dependencies.wayland-protocols]
version = "0.32"
features = ["client"]

[profile.dev]
opt-level = 1

[profile.dev.package."*"]
opt-level = 3

[dev-dependencies.pelicano]
git = "https://github.com/feather-works/pelicano.git"
tag = "v0.1.27"
features = ["terminal", "highlighter"]

[package]
name = "pelicano"
version = "0.1.27"
description = "Biblioteca de interface da suíte FeatherWorks: widgets, layout e janela próprios, sem Iced"
authors = ["FeatherWorks"]
edition = "2021"
license = "MIT"
repository = "https://github.com/feather-works/pelicano"
publish = false

[dependencies]
winit = "0.30"
softbuffer = "0.4"
tiny-skia = "0.11"
cosmic-text = "0.12"
resvg = "0.42"
wgpu = "0.19"
futures = "0.3"
window_clipboard = "0.4"
dark-light = "1"
accesskit = "0.25"
accesskit_winit = "0.34"

[dependencies.tokio]
version = "1"
features = ["rt-multi-thread", "time"]

[dependencies.pulldown-cmark]
version = "0.13"
default-features = false

[dependencies.syntect]
version = "5.3"
default-features = false
features = ["default-fancy"]
optional = true

[dependencies.alacritty_terminal]
version = "0.25"
optional = true

[features]
highlighter = ["dep:syntect"]
terminal = ["dep:alacritty_terminal"]

[profile.dev]
opt-level = 1

[profile.dev.package."*"]
opt-level = 3

[dev-dependencies.image]
version = "0.24"
default-features = false
features = ["jpeg"]

[[example]]
name = "terminal"
required-features = ["terminal"]

[[example]]
name = "explorer"
required-features = ["terminal"]

[[example]]
name = "vitrine"
required-features = ["terminal", "highlighter"]

[[example]]
name = "caderno"
path = "examples/caderno/main.rs"

[target."cfg(windows)".dependencies.windows-sys]
version = "0.59"
features = ["Win32_UI_WindowsAndMessaging"]

[source.vendored-sources]
directory = "cargo/vendor"

[source.crates-io]
replace-with = "vendored-sources"

[source."https://github.com/feather-works/falcao"]
git = "https://github.com/feather-works/falcao"
replace-with = "vendored-sources"
tag = "v0.1.1"

[source."https://github.com/feather-works/feather-charts"]
git = "https://github.com/feather-works/feather-charts"
replace-with = "vendored-sources"
tag = "v0.3.4"

[source."https://github.com/feather-works/feather-draw"]
git = "https://github.com/feather-works/feather-draw"
replace-with = "vendored-sources"
tag = "v0.1.1"

[source."https://github.com/feather-works/feather-io"]
git = "https://github.com/feather-works/feather-io"
replace-with = "vendored-sources"
tag = "v0.2.1"

[source."https://github.com/feather-works/feather-shapes"]
git = "https://github.com/feather-works/feather-shapes"
replace-with = "vendored-sources"
tag = "v0.1.2"

[source."https://github.com/feather-works/feather-ui"]
git = "https://github.com/feather-works/feather-ui"
replace-with = "vendored-sources"
tag = "v0.3.13"

[source."https://github.com/feather-works/pelicano"]
git = "https://github.com/feather-works/pelicano"
replace-with = "vendored-sources"
tag = "v0.1.27"
